===============================================
Field inside a supertype, below a hidden rule
===============================================

[a, ...b]

---

(source_file
  (list
    (name)
    spread: (spread
      (name))))

=============================================
Field on a hidden rule with a field inside it
=============================================

let a = b;

---

(source_file
  (binding
    inner: (name)
    outer: (name)))

==================================================
Field on a hidden rule whose only node has a field
==================================================

shadow a;

---

(source_file
  (shadow
    inner: (name)))

================================
A visible alias keeps its fields
================================

pair ...a, ...b;

---

(source_file
  (alias_pair
    (wrapped
      spread: (spread (name)))
    spread: (spread (name))))
